issues.detail: Hebrew פַּאֲרֵי הַמִּגְבָּעֹת means 'the ornaments/headpieces of the turbans' (or 'the turbans' headpieces'), not '細麻頭巾的榮耀' ('the glory of the linen turbans'). The word פְּאֵר (pa'er) means 'headpiece/ornament/turban', not 'glory' (which would be כָּבוֹד). This changes the meaning of the item described.
